name: epoch
description: Epoch workspace for core SDK, CLI, and WASM hosts.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @epoch/core && npm run build -w @epoch/cli && npm run build -w @epoch/wasm && npm run build -w @epoch/wasm-react && tsgo -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @epoch/core && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/cli && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/wasm && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/wasm-react && tsgo -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.features: npm run build -- --pretty false && npm run test:features:runtime
scripts.test:runtime: npm run test:unit:runtime && npm run test:features:runtime
scripts.coverage: npm run build -- --pretty false && c8 npm run test:runtime
scripts.test: npm run build -- --pretty false && npm run test:runtime
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run coverage
